title: Planet Tweaks V3.3.1 NOVA TITAN - Complete Hone, Aphrodite & Z-Tweaks Integration, 0-Delay Invariant TSC, Non-AI Matte Obsidian Design
releaseNotes: Planet Tweaks V3.3.1 NOVA TITAN: (1) Hone, Aphrodite & Z-Tweaks Full Absorption: Integrated 295+ competitive optimizations across registry, kernel timing, and network priority into Random Tweaks. (2) Pure Zero Delay & Clix Max FPS Packs: Overhauled with Invariant TSC 0.500ms kernel timer, DSCP CS7 packet priority, 8000Hz peripheral unthrottling, and purged generic browser filler. (3) Non-AI Design System: Standardized clean matte dark UI styling, purged emojis, and added Hardware Compatibility Shield for unsupported hardware. (4) Zero-Drop Input Engine: Hardcoded 0ms keyboard acceptance delay, 8-packet mouse queue, and restored Sprint Edit & Shotgun Pre-Fire macros.
